rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.notes: Kitchen Round 1 (swipe results Oct 11): two-island layout. A 10-ft quartzite waterfall island with stools along one side, a work island with flush induction, rift white oak flat-slab handleless cabinets, a 48" pro gas range with a high-heat wok burner under a hood hidden in the cabinetry, an integrated quartzite sink carved from the counter under a garden-view window, a lift-and-slide wall that pockets fully open to the pergola, a skylight with a linear suspended light, open oak shelves, an appliance garage, a built-in stainless fridge, a steam oven wall, the walk-in pantry and the hydroponic herb wall.
rooms.fin: Large-format honed stone tile floor; lime plaster walls; rift white oak flat-slab handleless cabinets, flush inset in face frames (finger-pull reveals); honed quartzite counters, waterfall island + integrated quartzite sink; honed marble slab backsplash (zellige alternate); 48" pro gas range with wok burner; hidden 1,500 m3/h hood insert in oak cabinetry; brushed stainless faucet; built-in stainless fridge; steam oven + wall oven column; flush 2-zone induction in the work island; open rift oak shelves; skylight + linear suspended LED

rooms.name: Dining
rooms.notes: Seats eight under exposed fir beams and a big paper lantern. Disappearing glass to the courtyard on the south and to the pergola dining terrace on the north.
rooms.fin: Walnut herringbone; lime plaster; exposed fir beams; cedar ceiling; dining table (open item); mixed chairs: Windsor (walnut) on the courtyard side, Shaker (cherry) on the north side; paper lantern

rooms.name: Living
rooms.notes: The heart of the house, fully open to the garden: 21 ft of pocketing glass to the courtyard and a big fixed mountain-view window to the north. Flat floor (the sunken conversation pit was dropped, Oct 20 deck) with a low modular sofa group, cognac leather lounge chair, paper lanterns, shoji screens to the dining room, and art on the east wall. A slim linear gas fire sits in a lime-plaster plinth (no stone fireplace).
rooms.fin: Walnut herringbone; lime plaster; exposed fir beams; cedar ceiling; low linen sofa group (flat floor); classic leather lounger; paper lanterns over the seating + woven pendants by the north window; shoji screens; frameless corner glass at the courtyard corner; bronze frames elsewhere; art wall

rooms.name: Walk-in Pantry
rooms.notes: Floor-to-ceiling open honey-oak shelving, second fridge, appliance counter.
rooms.fin: Large-format honed limestone; lime plaster; walnut open shelving

rooms.name: Mudroom + Gear
rooms.notes: Side entry from the bike racks and kitchen garden. Cubbies, boot bench, ski and helmet wall, dog wash.
rooms.fin: Large-format honed limestone; lime plaster; built-in walnut cubbies; stone dog wash

rooms.name: Master Bedroom
rooms.notes: Floor-to-ceiling glass to the mountains with sheer linen curtains, cove lighting, and a big fan under a wood ceiling. Low linen-wrapped bed against a lime-plaster headwall ledge (no wood platform or headboard), and a pair of lounge chairs at the view window.
rooms.fin: Walnut floor; lime plaster; built-in cherry joinery (flush inset); shoji doors; wood ceiling with cove lighting; sheer linen curtains; big ceiling fan; linen bed; bronze window frames

rooms.name: Master Bath
rooms.notes: Deep Japanese hinoki soaking tub at the corner window under a skylight. Open walk-in rain shower behind a black-stone wall (no glass enclosure), one long floating oak vanity with integrated stone basins and matte black taps, and a WC room. Opens to a walled bath garden.
rooms.fin: Honed limestone floor and walls; green zellige shower wall; hinoki soaking tub; built-in cherry vanity recessed into the wall, flush inset doors, integrated basins; unlacquered brass taps (mount: open item); skylight

rooms.name: Master Closet
rooms.notes: Walk-in closet with honey-oak millwork and a center island.
rooms.fin: Walnut floor; cherry millwork; lime plaster; shoji door

rooms.name: East Engawa Gallery
rooms.notes: Glazed engawa along the courtyard: honey-oak floor, sliding glass, a long low bench and wall-mounted art. Links living, bedrooms and the wellness wing.
rooms.fin: Walnut floor; lime plaster; bronze sliding glass

rooms.name: Laundry
rooms.notes: Stays in the sleeping wing, now at its south end off the east engawa: stacked W/D pair, folding counter, drying rack. Window to the south.
rooms.fin: Honed limestone; lime plaster; white cabinets

rooms.name: Linen + Mechanical
rooms.notes: Shallow linen + mechanical closet run along the kids' wing: linen shelves, heat pump air handler, ERV, water heating.
rooms.fin: Sealed concrete; painted plaster

rooms.name: Kids' Room 1
rooms.notes: Grow-into-teen 14 x 13 ft room: bed under a bunk/play loft (about 8 x 13 ft at 7 ft up, ladder), a desk by the east window, window-seat reading nook, cube shelves, small bouldering wall. Reached through its walk-in closet; shares the Jack-and-Jill bath.
rooms.fin: Walnut floor; calm white lime plaster; cherry desk, window seat and cube shelves; oak bunk/play loft with rail; bouldering panel

rooms.name: Jack-and-Jill Bath
rooms.notes: Kept: Jack-and-Jill between the two kids' rooms, one room with two sinks (a double cherry vanity), WC and a tiled tub-shower, lockable from each side. 20 x 6 ft.
rooms.fin: Honed limestone; white tile tub-shower; cherry double vanity; unlacquered brass taps

rooms.name: Kids' Room 2
rooms.notes: Kids only now (no longer the guest room). Grow-into-teen 14 x 13 ft room: twin/full bed under a bunk/play loft (about 8 x 13 ft at 7 ft up, ladder), a desk by the east window, window seat, cube shelves. Reached through its walk-in closet; no courtyard door (courtyard is reached from the engawa gallery). Shares the Jack-and-Jill bath.
rooms.fin: Walnut floor; calm white lime plaster; cherry desk, window seat and cube shelves; oak bunk/play loft with rail

rooms.name: Pool Equipment
rooms.notes: Unconditioned. Saltwater pool equipment: variable-speed pump, cartridge filter, heat pump heater and the salt chlorine generator cell (replace the cell about every 3-5 years). Ties into the utility yard next door. Exterior access only.
rooms.fin: Sealed concrete

rooms.name: Kids' Entry + Lockers
rooms.notes: The one kids' entry (replaces the two vestibules): one door from the east engawa, a bench and a row of honey-oak lockers with hooks and cubbies. Leads to both rooms' walk-in closets and the study nook.
rooms.fin: Walnut floor; lime plaster; cherry lockers + bench

rooms.name: Shared Study Nook
rooms.notes: Shared homework nook open to the kids' entry: a 14-ft built-in desk for two, task lights, a pin-board wall and book shelves. Each room also has its own desk.
rooms.fin: Walnut floor; lime plaster; cherry built-in desk + shelves; cork pin wall

rooms.name: South Covered Walkway
rooms.notes: Open-air covered walkway (not conditioned) under the wellness-wing eave, closing the courtyard ring. Flagstone floor, open to the courtyard, with glass doors into the east and west galleries.
rooms.fin: Flagstone floor; open-air, covered by the wellness-wing roof; cedar soffit

rooms.name: Exercise Room
rooms.notes: Calm studio look: honey-oak floor with a rubber lifting area, a high wood ceiling, and a mirror wall. Free-standing rig with wood rings and a climbing rope, Pilates Cadillac and reformer, wood water rower, treadmill, kettlebell and dumbbell rack, and a bars-and-bands wall. Glass slides open to the sprint lane and an outdoor pull-up station. Enlarged Oct 20 (wellness is the top priority): now 22 x 27 ft.
rooms.fin: Walnut floor; rubber lifting tiles; lime plaster; high wood ceiling; mirror wall; black steel rig; wood rings

rooms.name: Wet Room
rooms.notes: Black-stone wet room: two rain showers, a built-in cold plunge lined in green zellige (39-50 F), teak bench. Serves the sauna and steam room. Enlarged Oct 20 to 16 x 18 ft with a recovery lounge corner (zero-gravity chairs).
rooms.fin: Honed limestone floor; Japanese earth-plaster walls (tadelakt-style sealed); green zellige plunge; teak bench; unlacquered brass rain showers

rooms.name: Sauna
rooms.notes: Warm cedar walls with tiered pale-aspen benches, backlit underneath, and an electric rock heater (no wood stove). Low window toward the pool and meadow.
rooms.fin: Cedar walls and ceiling; pale aspen tiered benches, backlit; aspen duckboard floor; electric rock heater

rooms.name: Steam Room
rooms.notes: Stone steam room (not a white hammam): honed black stone on the walls, floor and heated bench.
rooms.fin: Honed black stone floor, walls and heated bench (kept: steam needs an impervious stone)

rooms.name: Changing + Towels
rooms.notes: Towels, robes, honey-oak lockers and a rinse shower. Pool access through the wellness wing: door to the pool deck and outdoor shower, and a door from the open south walkway, so the courtyard reaches the pool too.
rooms.fin: Honed limestone; lime plaster; cherry lockers

rooms.name: Entry Genkan
rooms.notes: Stone genkan with a step-up to the oak floor, a rammed-earth feature wall and one large artwork. Solid charred-oak pivot door (no glass entry). The first view lines up across the engawa into the courtyard.
rooms.fin: Large-format honed limestone; rammed-earth feature wall; lime plaster; kumiko lattice screen; bronze front door (style + timber: open item)

rooms.name: Coat + Shoe Closet
rooms.notes: Coat and shoe storage.
rooms.fin: Walnut floor; walnut millwork

rooms.name: Powder Room
rooms.notes: Compact powder room by the entry: integrated stone basin, lime-plaster walls.
rooms.fin: Honed limestone; lime plaster; integrated stone basin; unlacquered brass tap

rooms.name: Tea + Reading Room
rooms.notes: 8-mat (12 x 12 ft) tatami room, now a tea + reading room: tokonoma, low tea table, zabuton, a wall of book shelves and a reading lamp. Futons in the fusuma closet turn it into an extra guest bed. Shoji slide open to the engawa and courtyard.
rooms.fin: Tatami; lime plaster; shoji to the engawa; fusuma closet doors; walnut tokonoma; book shelves; futon storage

rooms.name: Sound Lock + AV Closet
rooms.notes: Sound lock vestibule between the west engawa and the studio: two solid-core doors with full perimeter seals and automatic drop seals, so one is always closed. Also holds the AV rack and instrument storage.
rooms.fin: Walnut floor; painted plaster; two solid-core doors with perimeter + drop seals

rooms.name: West Engawa Gallery
rooms.notes: Glazed engawa from the entry to the office and great room.
rooms.fin: Walnut floor; lime plaster; bronze sliding glass

rooms.name: Isolated Studio / Office
rooms.notes: Fully isolated room-within-a-room studio that is still a great work office: sit-stand desk facing the garden, studio desk with mixer and MPC, digital piano, e-drums, guitar wall and sofa. Decoupled inner stud walls on resilient isolation mounts (about 14 in total wall build-up per side), a floated floor on isolation pads, an isolated ceiling on spring hangers, laminated double glazing with an air gap, and quiet decoupled HVAC with lined ducts and silencers. Target STC 60+ (about 60-65 dB isolation) and NC-20 inside. Enlarged Oct 20 to 28 x 22 ft: 616 SF gross, about 505 SF net inside the inner shell (25 ft 8 in x 19 ft 8 in). Still entered only through the sound lock (405).
rooms.fin: Floated walnut floor on isolation pads; decoupled inner walls on resilient mounts; isolated ceiling; laminated double glazing in bronze frames; solid-core doors with seals (not shoji, to keep STC 60+); lined ducts; lime plaster; walnut desks; fabric acoustic panels; acoustic ceiling clouds; sculpted wood ceiling; skylight; layered pendants

rooms.name: Guest Bedroom
rooms.notes: Full guest suite near the entry (west): 14 x 14 ft bedroom with a queen bed, reading chair and garden windows to the west. Reached from the genkan by a short guest hall, away from the family rooms.
rooms.fin: Walnut floor; lime plaster; shoji to the hall; linen bed; bronze windows
